name: realism-wave4-materials
description: Wave 4A coordinated pass — wood-grain retune A/B (wardrobe, bookshelf, tv-console dark, crib, changing-table + a floor frame), appliance finish toggle (fridge/washer steel->matte->gloss), curtain-sill standoff (blackout drawn), fireplace wall vs console.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: set-daytime
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setManualHour?.(13)

steps.name: dismiss-hints
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); s.dismissCallout?.('empty-room-hint'); s.dismissCallout?.('room-editor'); })()

steps.name: compute-anchors
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); const fp = st.floorPlan; const room = fp.rooms.find(r => r.id === st.roomEditor.roomId) || fp.rooms.find(r => r.id === 'livingDining'); if (!room) throw new Error('no living/dining room'); const ox = room.origin[0], oz = room.origin[1], W = room.width, D = room.depth; window.__room = { ox, oz, W, D, cx: ox + W/2, cz: oz + D/2 }; const byId = Object.fromEntries(fp.walls.map(w => [w.id, w])); const centre = (o) => { const w = byId[o.wallId]; const dx = w.end[0]-w.start[0], dz = w.end[1]-w.start[1]; const len = Math.hypot(dx,dz); const t = o.offset + o.width/2; return { id:o.id, kind:o.kind, cx: w.start[0]+dx/len*t, cz: w.start[1]+dz/len*t, nx:-dz/len, nz:dx/len, width:o.width, sill:o.sill, head:o.head }; }; const ops = fp.openings.filter(o => byId[o.wallId]).map(centre); const inRoom = (p) => p.cx >= ox-0.6 && p.cx <= ox+W+0.6 && p.cz >= oz-0.6 && p.cz <= oz+D+0.6; const wins = ops.filter(o => o.kind==='window'); window.__win = wins.find(inRoom) || wins[0]; console.log('anchors', JSON.stringify(window.__room), 'win', window.__win && window.__win.id); })()

steps.name: place-wardrobe
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().setItems([{ id:'wardrobe', defId:'wardrobe-3door', position:[r.cx, r.cz], rotation:0, props:{} }]); })()

steps.name: frame-wardrobe
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[r.cx, 1.1, r.cz], radius:2.2}); })()

steps.name: close-wardrobe
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[r.cx, 1.4, r.cz], radius:1.1}); })()

steps.name: place-bookshelf
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().setItems([{ id:'bookshelf', defId:'bookshelf', position:[r.cx, r.cz], rotation:0, props:{ variant:'closed' } }]); })()

steps.name: frame-bookshelf
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[r.cx, 1.0, r.cz], radius:1.9}); })()

steps.name: place-tvconsole
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().setItems([{ id:'tvc', defId:'tv-console', position:[r.cx, r.cz], rotation:0, props:{} }]); })()

steps.name: frame-tvc
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[r.cx, 0.4, r.cz], radius:1.6}); })()

steps.name: place-crib
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().setItems([{ id:'crib', defId:'crib', position:[r.cx, r.cz], rotation:0, props:{} }]); })()

steps.name: frame-crib
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[r.cx, 0.6, r.cz], radius:1.4}); })()

steps.name: place-changing
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().setItems([{ id:'ct', defId:'changing-table', position:[r.cx, r.cz], rotation:0, props:{} }]); })()

steps.name: frame-ct
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[r.cx, 0.65, r.cz], radius:1.4}); })()

steps.name: frame-floor
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[r.cx, 0.0, r.cz], radius:2.8}); })()

steps.name: place-fridge-washer
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().setItems([{ id:'fridge', defId:'refrigerator', position:[r.cx-0.7, r.cz], rotation:0, props:{ body:'steel' } }, { id:'washer', defId:'washing-machine', position:[r.cx+0.7, r.cz], rotation:0, props:{ body:'steel' } }]); })()

steps.name: frame-appl
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[r.cx, 0.9, r.cz], radius:2.2}); })()

steps.name: toggle-matte
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); s.updateItemProps?.('fridge', { body:'matte' }); s.updateItemProps?.('washer', { body:'matte' }); })()

steps.name: toggle-gloss
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); s.updateItemProps?.('fridge', { body:'gloss' }); s.updateItemProps?.('washer', { body:'gloss' }); })()

steps.name: toggle-back-steel
steps.eval: (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); s.updateItemProps?.('fridge', { body:'steel' }); s.updateItemProps?.('washer', { body:'steel' }); })()

steps.name: place-fireplace-wall
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().setItems([{ id:'fp', defId:'fireplace', position:[r.cx, r.oz+0.2], rotation:0, props:{ style:'wall' } }]); })()

steps.name: frame-fp1
steps.eval: (function(){ const r = window.__room; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[r.cx, 1.0, r.oz+0.4], radius:1.8}); })()

steps.name: fireplace-console
steps.eval: (function(){ window.__store.getState().updateItemProps?.('fp', { style:'console' }); })()

steps.name: drop-curtain-near-window
steps.eval: (function(){ const w = window.__win; const r = window.__room; let ux = r.cx - w.cx, uz = r.cz - w.cz; const l = Math.hypot(ux, uz) || 1; ux/=l; uz/=l; window.__store.getState().setGhostWorld([w.cx + ux*0.4, w.cz + uz*0.4], true); window.__winC=[w.cx, w.cz, w.sill||0.4]; })()

steps.name: click-curtain
steps.eval: (function(){ const c = document.querySelector('canvas'); c.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0 })); })()

steps.name: curtain-committed
steps.failMessage: The curtain should commit (windowBound snap) and disarm

steps.name: curtain-blackout-drawn
steps.eval: (function(){ const it = window.__store.getState().items.find(i => i.defId==='curtains'); if(it) window.__store.getState().updateItemProps?.(it.id, { drawAmount:1, lightBlock:'blackout', color:'#3a3f46' }); })()

steps.name: frame-cur
steps.eval: (function(){ const c = window.__winC; const w = window.__win; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[c[0]+w.nx*0.6, (w.sill||0.4)+0.15, c[1]+w.nz*0.6], radius:1.4}); })()

steps.name: close-cur-sill
steps.eval: (function(){ const c = window.__winC; const w = window.__win; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection?.({center:[c[0]+w.nx*0.5, (w.sill||0.4)+0.05, c[1]+w.nz*0.5], radius:0.8}); })()
